verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents dedicated 'Fast' serverless variants for latency-sensitive workloads targeting 100+ tokens/sec, plus speculative decoding to cut generation latency. Its docs also describe on-demand dedicated GPUs with lower latency and higher throughput, quantization, sticky routing for prompt-cache hits, no cold starts on serverless, and an open-source benchmarking tool for latency and throughput testing. Missing for 10: explicit time-to-first-token figures or guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the speed claims.
